subject: Request: vendor lineage & encryption evidence for Greenfield Pharma procurement
messages:
From: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@greenfieldpharma.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, procurement@greenfieldpharma.com
Cc: tpr@greenfieldpharma.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — vendor lineage, KMS, and subprocessor separation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and third-party risk teams are moving toward a recommendation but need a few items to complete the assessment for Redwood:

1) A current roster of all subprocessors (including cloud infra, monitoring, logging, and any 3rd-party model providers you call at inference time) and the country of operation for each.
2) A short KMS/keyflow diagram showing where customer keys are stored, who can access them, and whether keys leave the customer-managed boundary.
3) Confirmation of which components are covered by your SOC 2 scope (auth, telemetry, data-at-rest encryption).
4) Any SBOM or third-party library disclosure for inference-serving containers (we can accept a pointer to an internal artifact if that's easier).

If possible, can you provide these artifacts by EOD Mon (Aug 2)? If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min call with our TPR analyst to walk through the evidence.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we have a procurement committee meeting on Aug 5.

Best,
Emma Zhou
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greenfield Pharma

--
Emma Zhou
Greenfield Pharma
emma.zhou@greenfieldpharma.com
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@greenfieldpharma.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:08:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — vendor lineage, KMS, and subprocessor separation

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick answers up front:

- We'll attach a current subprocessor roster with country and purpose.
- I'll include a KMS keyflow diagram that shows customer-managed KMS options (bring-your-own-key) and our default managed KMS flow.
- SOC 2: our production inference control plane and runtime (auth, telemetry, encryption at rest) are in-scope; I'll mark which components are explicitly excluded.
- SBOM: we can provide a SBOM for our inference container images and a short mapping of which packages are pulled from public registries.

Attachments: redwood-sig-lite-answers-20260729.pdf (SIG-lite Q&A), subprocessor_roster_20260729.csv, kms_keyflow_diagram.png. I'm also dropping a shared Drive folder with the artifacts.

If your TPR analyst wants to talk through the KMS and separation model, laura and marcus can join. Otherwise, we'll deliver the artifacts and a short write-up by EOD Mon (Aug 2).

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: redwood-sig-lite-answers-20260729.pdf (application/pdf), subprocessor_roster_20260729.csv (text/csv), kms_keyflow_diagram.png (image/png)
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 08:22:10 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request — Greenfield Pharma (packaging plan)

Jonas / Marcus — forwarding Emma's request and Jonas' draft. Action items before we push to the Drive: 

- Marcus: please add a one-paragraph description next to each subprocessor row describing the exact data type processed (e.g., telemetry-only, logs with redacted tokens, model weights retrieval). Mark any EU-based subprocessors.
- Marcus & Jonas: confirm whether any inference-time model downloads originate from third-party model hosts (we need SBOM alignment if so).
- Jonas: update the SIG-lite answers to call out SOC 2 control ID references (so their TPR can crosswalk).
- I'll draft a 1-pager mapping the requested artifacts to the procurement checklist items to make it easy for their committee.

Let's aim to have the finalized folder by Mon 2026-08-02 12:00 PDT so Jonas can send with a short cover email.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

--- Original message attached above ---
From: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@greenfieldpharma.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@greenfieldpharma.com, tpr@greenfieldpharma.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — vendor lineage & encryption evidence for Greenfield Pharma procurement

Jonas / Laura / Marcus — thank you, this is exactly what we needed. The subprocessor roster and KMS diagram remove the primary blockers for our TPR review. A couple of small follow-ups:

- Can you confirm whether logging telemetry that contains redacted request IDs is retained for 30 days by default and whether that retention can be shortened per contract?
- We saw a line about a third-party model cache — could you confirm whether model artifacts are fetched from external hosts or from an internal mirror?

If convenient, let's take a 20-minute call tomorrow at 9:30am PT to close these two items. Otherwise we can accept the follow-up in writing.

Assuming we get quick confirmation, procurement expects to move to a recommended vendor decision on Aug 5.

Best,
Emma
